name: print-social-white-and-mint-zigzag-modular-design-developers-slide
title: Modular Design for Developers Zigzag Slide
whatItIs: A white portrait slide with a bright mint zigzag band at the top and a pale one at the base, a big black tightly set heading 'Modular Design and Flexibility for Developers' with 'Developers' in mint, a paragraph and an arrow tile with an extra note.
whatItMeans: The same zigzag system in a lighter arrangement keeps the series consistent while changing the mood.
techniques: Zigzag band cropped at the top edge
Tight heavy headline with a mint accent word
Paragraph and arrow-tile note under it
Pale ghost zigzag at the base
bestFor: Series with a repeated graphic motif
White and mint minimal type slides

vocabulary.definition: A graphic repeated across slides to unify them.
A very pale version of a graphic used as a background.
Very small spacing between lines of a headline.
